description: One spelling a receipt printer uses for one vendor, and the Supplier it actually is. `SIATAPING` on a thermal slip is Sawyer's Ace Hardware, and no amount of string similarity will ever say so — the letters are not there. So this is a TAUGHT mapping rather than a computed one: it is written the moment a bookkeeper links a receipt to a Supplier by hand, and every later receipt carrying that same spelling resolves to the same vendor without anybody being asked twice. The docname is the alias NORMALISED — upper-cased, punctuation dropped, legal-form words removed — which is what makes 'Valley Co-op #14' and 'VALLEY CO-OP 14' one row instead of two, and what makes 'one alias resolves to exactly one Supplier' a primary key rather than a rule somebody has to remember. Nothing here is ever inferred from the alias table alone: it records a decision a person already made, and replays it.

fields.description: The merchant string exactly as it was captured off the paper, before anything was stripped from it. Kept as printed because it is the evidence: a reader asking why 'SIATAPING' resolves to a hardware store needs to see the string the scanner actually read, not a tidied version of it.
fields.label: Alias

fields.description: What that spelling actually is. A Link, so the mapping dies with the Supplier rather than outliving it as a string pointing at nothing.
fields.label: Canonical Supplier

fields.description: The alias upper-cased with punctuation dropped and legal-form words (Co, LLC, Inc, Corp, Ltd …) removed — the key a lookup is done on, and the docname. Derived by the controller from `alias`; editing it by hand would make the row unfindable by the receipts it exists to resolve.
fields.label: Alias Key

fields.description: How this mapping was learned. Manual is a person linking a receipt to a Supplier, and is the only source a replay of it is allowed to treat as certain — it is somebody's own decision handed back to them. Auto is this app's own high-confidence name match, and LLM is a model reading the raw receipt text; both are opinions that happened to be recorded, and they resolve at the same ceiling every other guess in this app does.
fields.label: Source

fields.description: How many receipts this alias has resolved since it was learned, itself included. It is the only measure of whether a taught mapping was worth teaching — a row that has never fired again is a one-off spelling, and a row in the hundreds is a vendor this farm buys from every week.
fields.label: Match Count

fields.description: The last day a receipt resolved through this alias. Read-only, and the answer to 'is this mapping still live or did that vendor close in 2024'.
fields.label: Last Matched On

fields.description: The Expense Receipt whose supplier link taught this mapping. A mapping nobody can trace back to the paper that produced it is a mapping nobody can argue with — the same reason a categorised Bank Transaction carries the rule that categorised it.
fields.label: First Learned From

name: Merchant Alias
